title: Part
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees in all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. This sketch consists of a closed loop formed by four lines. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.75, 0.0). The second line runs from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0525). The third line goes from (0.75, 0.0525) to (0.0, 0.0525), and the fourth line completes the loop by connecting (0.0, 0.0525) back to the origin. After drawing the sketch, apply a scale factor of 0.75 to reduce its size proportionally. Transform this scaled sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero and translating it with a vector also set to zero. Finally, extrude the sketch 0.009 units along the normal direction to create a new solid body. The resulting shape is a rectangular base with rounded edges, measuring 0.75 units in length, 0.0525 units in width, and 0.009 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0525) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0525) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.009)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# The part is a long thin flat bar, 0.75 (X) by 0.0525 (Y) by 0.009 (Z).
# The top view shows small chamfered corners at the two ends.

chamfer = 0.003  # small chamfer at the end corners

r = cq.Workplane("XY")
r = r.moveTo(chamfer, 0) \
     .lineTo(0.75 - chamfer, 0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, chamfer) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0525 - chamfer) \
     .lineTo(0.75 - chamfer, 0.0525) \
     .lineTo(chamfer, 0.0525) \
     .lineTo(0, 0.0525 - chamfer) \
     .lineTo(0, chamfer) \
     .close()

r = r.extrude(0.009)
